scope: Fixed original35 and unchanged engine. Three previously unused validation variants; direct frozen IDs; separate quality/timing/greedy-answer stages.
memory_scope: M0 is after context initialization, including hot initialization for CSP. Gpre/Gpost remain logged in hot-backend guards. Bank is used in CSP T1 only. M1 vision warmup builds/reserves dummy shape, not real-image compute. CUDA then NVML are sequential queries; M3 after main-model T1 is retained allocation, not instantaneous peak.
input_policy: Frozen prefix/continuation IDs only; no template application and no tokenization. Free answer receives prefix only.
